name: THRA / THRB
why_it_matters: A chemical can alter thyroid signaling without changing circulating hormone concentration if it changes transport, metabolism or receptor-level action.

name: ERα / ERβ
why_it_matters: Estrogenic activity is a major mechanistic domain in endocrine-disruption research.

name: AR
why_it_matters: Androgen agonism, antagonism and altered steroidogenesis are distinct mechanisms.

name: GR
why_it_matters: Stress-axis endpoints can reflect receptor signaling as well as altered hormone secretion.

name: TSHR
why_it_matters: Endocrine signaling can be disrupted upstream at gland stimulation, not only at final hormone receptors.

name: INSR
why_it_matters: Metabolic endocrine effects involve both hormone concentration and tissue sensitivity.

name: GHR
why_it_matters: Growth signaling illustrates endocrine crosstalk with metabolism and tissue-specific responses.

name: OXTR
why_it_matters: Not all endocrine systems follow a classic hypothalamus→pituitary→peripheral-gland architecture.
